existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Postage fee limited to actual cost
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Fees for postage may not exceed the actual cost of mailing.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Fees for postage may not exceed the actual cost of mailing.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Duplication fees set by Office of Open Records schedule
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Duplication fees for Commonwealth and local agencies (absent an agency-specific fee schedule) are established by the Office of Open Records and must be reasonable and based on prevailing fees for comparable duplication services provided by local business entities.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Fees for duplication by a Commonwealth agency or a local agency shall be established by the Office of Open Records. Fees shall be reasonable and based on prevailing fees for comparable duplication services provided by local business entities.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Paraphrase of § 1307(b); the concrete per-page value lives in the OOR fee schedule (PA-0040).

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: OOR Official RTKL Fee Schedule — per-copy photocopy rate
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Under the OOR Official RTKL Fee Schedule, an agency may charge up to $0.25 per copy for black-and-white photocopies (8.5x11 or 8.5x14), reduced to $0.20 per copy beyond the first 1,000 copies.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Up to $0.25 per copy for black and white copies (a 'copy' is one side of an 8.5x11 or 8.5x14 page); up to $0.20 per copy beyond the first 1,000 copies.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_authority: OOR Official RTKL Fee Schedule (adopted Dec. 30, 2024), issued under 65 P.S. § 67.1307(b)
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Value set by OOR schedule, not the statute; confirm current amounts and tiering against the linked PDF. Ceiling the city applies its actual (lower) value under.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: An agency may impose reasonable fees for official certification of copies where the certification is at the requester's behest and for the purpose of legally verifying the public record.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: An agency may impose reasonable fees for official certification of copies if the certification is at the behest of the requester and for the purpose of legally verifying the public record.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Subsection letter approximate; 'reasonable' is a soft-standard, no fixed number.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: No fee for reviewing a record to determine access
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: No fee may be imposed for an agency's review of a record to determine whether it is a public, legislative or financial record subject to access.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Agency reviews record for access determination
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: No fee may be imposed for an agency's review of a record to determine whether the record is a public record, legislative record or financial record subject to access.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Fixed at $0 — agency may not charge for exemption-review/redaction-decision time.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: An agency may waive duplication fees, including when the requester duplicates the record or when the agency deems it in the public interest to do so.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: An agency may waive the fees for duplication of a record, including, but not limited to, when: (1) the requester duplicates the record; or (2) the agency deems it is in the public interest to do so.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Fee for records maintained only in electronic/nonpaper media
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: If a record is maintained only electronically or in nonpaper media, duplication fees are limited to the lesser of the paper-duplication fee or the original-media fee under § 1307(b), unless the requester specifically requests the more expensive medium.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Record maintained only in nonpaper media
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: If a record is only maintained electronically or in other nonpaper media, duplication fees shall be limited to the lesser of the fee for duplication on paper or the fee for duplication in the original media as provided by subsection (b) unless the requester specifically requests for the record to be duplicated in the more expensive medium.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: User fees for enhanced electronic access
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: If an agency offers enhanced electronic access to records in addition to the inspection-and-duplication access required by the act, it may establish user fees specifically for the provision of that enhanced electronic access.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Agency offers optional enhanced electronic access
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: If an agency offers enhanced electronic access to records in addition to making the records accessible for inspection and duplication by a requester as required by this act, the agency may establish user fees specifically for the provision of the enhanced electronic access.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Subsection letter approximate; enhanced access is optional, separate from statutory access.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: An agency may require a requester to prepay an estimate of the authorized fees if the fees required to fulfill the request are expected to exceed $100.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: An agency may require a requester to prepay an estimate of the fees authorized under this section if the fees required to fulfill the request are expected to exceed $100.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: $100 is a fixed trigger threshold; in practice prepayment gates production (may pause fulfillment until paid), and nonpayment is an extension ground under PA-0023 factor (6).
